strategies.name: Only after 1+ loss
strategies.description: Only trade if previous trade was a loss. Mean-reversion logic.

strategies.name: Only after 2+ losses
strategies.description: Only trade after 2+ consecutive losses. Strongest mean-reversion signal.

strategies.name: Skip after 2 wins
strategies.description: Skip if last 2 trades were wins (exactly 2, not 3+). Avoids exhaustion.

strategies.name: Combined Markov
strategies.description: Skip after exactly 2 wins + always take after 2+ losses.

strategies.name: Only after win (momentum)
strategies.description: Only trade if previous was a win. Momentum logic.

strategies.name: After loss + score≥4
strategies.description: Mean-reversion + require score ≥ 4 for quality filter.
